title: Capture (module)
excerpt: Capture module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) to record/resample 24bit stereo audio into /media/orac/captures , includes...
content:
Capture module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) to record/resample 24bit stereo audio into /media/orac/captures , includes SuperCompress.

#1 : copy capture_module_1-5.zop to /Patches
#2 : reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 : run "Install capture_module..."

v1.5 : compatibility with the Transport module : can be started, stopped and armed from the Transport module to record at start, minor UI bugfix

v1.4 : now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/sampler , captures are now into /media/orac/captures , new file-name system : captures are now named starting from 00001.wav and can be renamed/removed without issues.

v1.3 : UI bugfixes, thru gain automatically set to 0%
